proposed.text: Under the Architect's Guidelines, what is the recommended fee percentage for a Group 1 project (Simplest Utilization and Character) with a Project Construction Cost of ₱50 million or less?
proposed.rationale: the Architect's Guidelines specifies that Group 1 (Simplest Utilization and Character) projects with PCC of ₱50M or less carry a DAEDS fee of 5% of PCC. [B]: 6% is the base rate for Group 2 (Moderate Complexity), not Group 1. [C]: 7% is the base rate for Group 3 (Exceptional Character), not Group 1. [D]: 8% is an outdated rate from the 1979 UAP schedule — the Architect's Guidelines revised these percentages.
